content.title: Google LLC | The ClassAction.org Legal News Wire
content.text: Lawsuit Filings $5M Google Settlement Ends Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Automatically Renewing Google Play Store Subscriptions March 13, 2026 A $5M Google settlement ends a class action lawsuit alleging that its automatically recurring Google Play Store subscriptions violated California law. Class Action Lawsuit Claims Google Shares Vast Amounts of Consumer Data with ‘Most Scrutinized’ Chinese Tech Companies February 24, 2026 A class action lawsuit claims Google transmits massive amounts of sensitive consumer info to Chinese tech companies without meaningful notice or consent. $135M Google Settlement Resolves Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Android Cellular Data Collection, Transfers [UPDATE] February 2, 2026 A $135M Google settlement offers cash to over 100 million Android users who paid for cellular data that may have been tracked for targeted advertising. $68M Google Assistant Settlement Ends Class Action Lawsuit Claiming Devices Start Recording Without User Activation January 28, 2026 A $68M Google Assistant settlement ends a class action lawsuit alleging that enabled devices secretly recorded and transmitted private conversations. $700M Google Settlement Ends Attorneys General Lawsuit Over Alleged Monopoly of Android App Distribution December 11, 2025 A $700M Google settlement ends an attorneys general lawsuit that alleged the tech giant monopolized app distribution and in-app billing for Android mobile devices. Google Hit with Data Privacy Lawsuit After ‘Secretly’ Turning On Gemini AI for All Users November 13, 2025 A class action lawsuit alleges Google is tracking consumers' communications without consent after it 'secretly turned on' Gemini AI for all users. Combined $56M Google, Flo Settlement Ends Class Action Lawsuit Over Allegedly Illegal Health Data Sharing September 26, 2025 Google and Flo will pay a combined $56M to settle a class action alleging the menstrual tracking app illegally shared users’ data with Google and Meta. $6M+ YouTube Settlement Ends Class Action Over Use of Facial Recognition Tech in Illinois August 29, 2025 An over $6 million settlement ends litigation against YouTube over the allegedly illegal use of its Face Blur tool in Illinois. [UPDATE] $30M Google, YouTube Settlement Aims to Resolve Privacy Lawsuit Over Allegedly Unlawful Collection of Children’s Data August 28, 2025 A settlement has been reached that may resolve a class action that claimed Google and YouTube collected the personal data of millions of minors without parental consent. $8.75M Google Settlement Resolves Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Chromebook Privacy Violations August 1, 2025 A settlement has been reached to resolve a class action that claimed Google unlawfully captured Illinois students’ biometric data through its GWFE platform. Class Action Lawsuit Claims Meta, Yandex Track Android Users’ Data Without Consent June 19, 2025 A class action lawsuit claims Google did little to nothing to resist Meta and Yandex Metrica abusing Android software weaknesses to track users without consent. $100M Google AdWords Settlement Aims to Resolve Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Overpayments by Advertisers April 2, 2025 Google has agreed to pay a $100 million settlement that may resolve a class action over allegations that advertisers overpaid for ads through the AdWords program. $3.5 Million Flo App Settlement Aims to Resolve Data Harvesting Class Action Claims Against Flurry [UPDATE] March 31, 2025 If approved, a $3.5 million Flo app settlement will resolve class action claims that alleged Flurry illegally harvested user data from the popular period tracking tool. $28 Million Google Settlement Resolves Employee Racial Bias Class Action Lawsuit March 21, 2025 A $28 million settlement has been reached with Google to end a class action lawsuit that alleged the tech giant favored white and Asian employees. Class Action Lawsuit Claims Apple, Google Knowingly Facilitate Online Casino Apps’ Illegal Gambling Scheme December 10, 2024 A class action claims Apple and Google have knowingly assisted and profited from an illegal gambling scheme involving four online casino apps. GoodRx Agrees to Settle Data-Sharing Lawsuit for $25 Million [UPDATE] December 10, 2024 A $25 million settlement has been reached to resolve a class action that alleged GoodRx illegally shared users’ private information with Facebook, Google and Criteo without consent. Class Action Claims Nebula Secretly Shares Genetic Test Results With Facebook, Google, Microsoft October 15, 2024 Nebula Genomics faces a class action suit that alleges the DNA testing firm shares customers’ genetic testing results with third parties without consent. Google, Alphabet Stole Visual Artists’ Copyrighted Images to Train Imagen AI, Class Action Lawsuit Alleges May 2, 2024 Visual artists allege in a lawsuit that Google has violated federal copyright law by copying an enormous number of protected digital images to train the Imagen AI software. Google Illegally Pockets Money Stolen in Play Store Gift Card Scams, Class Action Alleges March 6, 2024 A proposed class action lawsuit accuses Google of having kept millions in stolen money from victims of Google Play Store gift card scams. Class Action Alleges Home Depot, Google ‘Wiretap’ Customer Service Calls February 26, 2024 A consumer claims in a class action that Home Depot allowed his customer service calls to be secretly “wiretapped” by Google without his consent. ‘Unusable’: Google Pixel Pro 6 Lawsuit Claims ‘Defective’ Smartphones Prone to Overheating February 16, 2024 A class action lawsuit alleges the Google Pixel 6 suffers from a “debilitating” defect that can cause the pricey smartphone to overheat and become unusable. Adam & Eve Shared Consumers’ Sex Toy Preferences with Google, Class Action Alleges January 11, 2024 A class action alleges consumers who browse AdamEve.com have had details of their sexual preferences, sexual orientation, sex toy preferences and more shared with Google without their consent. Google’s Cloud Contact Center AI Records Customer Service Calls Without Consent, Class Action Claims [DISMISSSED] November 2, 2023 A class action alleges Google’s Cloud Contact Center AI software has recorded, accessed, read and learned the contents of customer service calls without consent. Class Action Claims H&R Block Secretly Shares Consumers’ Tax Return Info with Meta, Google [UPDATE] October 2, 2023 A class action against H&R Block, Meta and Google claims the online tax service has secretly shared users’ tax return information with the tech giants. Google Collects H&R Block, TaxAct, TaxSlayer User Data Without Consent, Class Action Says August 23, 2023 Google faces a class action over its alleged use of tracking tools on major online tax filing websites to secretly collect consumers’ financial information. Google Hit with Class Action Over Alleged Use of Private, Copyrighted Data to Train AI Chatbot Bard July 17, 2023 A class action alleges Google has secretly harvested and used millions of internet users’ data to train its various artificial intelligence (AI) products. Google Facing Class Action Over Alleged Data Tracking on Healthcare Provider Websites May 22, 2023 Google faces a class action over its alleged use of tracking tools on healthcare provider websites and apps to secretly collect consumers’ sensitive health and personal information. Google Hit with Class Action After Certain Pixel Smartphones Lose 5G Network Support April 24, 2023 Google faces a class action after rolling out a software update that allegedly removed 5G SA network access from Pixel 4a, Pixel 5 and Pixel 5a smartphones. Class Action: TikTok, YouTube Reporting Features Ineffective in Shielding Minors from Harmful Content like ‘Choking Challenge' February 15, 2023 A class action claims TikTok and YouTube do not have in place adequate reporting processes removing harmful content, thereby exposing children to dangerous, harassing and sexually explicit material. [UPDATE] Class Action Alleges GoodRx Secretly Shares Prescription, Treatment Data with Facebook, Google [UPDATE] February 3, 2023 A class action alleges GoodRx has secretly shared consumer medical information with Google, Meta, Criteo and other major social media and advertising companies. Google Streaming Services Illegally Retain Video History, Class Action Alleges October 5, 2022 A class action alleges Google's video-streaming services unlawfully retain consumers' video rental history and personal information. [UPDATE] YouTube Class Action Claims Platform Illegally Captures, Stores Facial Scans in Illinois September 7, 2022 A class action alleges YouTube has run afoul of an Illinois biometric privacy law by capturing and storing scans of consumers’ faces by way of its “Face Blur” tool. Class Action Alleges Google Revoked ‘Free-for-Life’ Workspace Access August 10, 2022 A lawsuit claims Google unlawfully reneged on its promise to provide free access to its Workspace platform for users who signed up during a free-for-life promotion. Google Leverages Market Power to Hike Up Prices for Maps API Access, Class Action Alleges [DISMISSED] April 18, 2022 Google and Alphabet face a class action that alleges the tech giants have for years forced those who use their digital-mapping product APIs into a locked-in bundle of services before then hiking up the price. Google Hit with Class Action Over Alleged ‘Systemic’ Racial Discrimination March 21, 2022 A former Google university programs specialist alleges the search engine giant has engaged in a systemic pattern and practice of racial discrimination against African American and Black employees nationwide. Google Illegally Uses Restaurant Trade Names in Connection with ‘Illicit’ Online Ordering Storefront, Class Action Alleges March 9, 2022 A class action alleges Google has violated federal trademark law by using restaurant trade names without authorization in an effort to drive ad clicks. Class Action Claims Google Uses Android Lockbox Program to Spy on Smartphone Users November 29, 2021 A lawsuit claims Google unlawfully collected Android users’ personal data through an program known as “Android Lockbox” without first obtaining consent.
